purpose: Monitor and compare academic year targets across categories and programs to support strategic planning.
questions: Is the total target increasing compared to the previous academic year?
Which category contributes the most to the overall target?
How does each program's target share change over time?
Are there any programs with declining target levels year-over-year?

kpis.name: Total Target
kpis.limitations: Small dataset (10 records); targets may represent program-level goals and summing across categories could double-count if programs overlap.

kpis.name: Average Target per Program
kpis.limitations: Average across programs; assumes each program target is comparable.

filters: Academic_Year (ปีการศึกษา)สำหรับฟิว
